details.availability: Chrome Web Store extension; no source repository is published

name: AutoBrowser
notes: The Chrome Web Store listing names browser-use as its inspiration, shows version 1.1.1 updated February 27, 2025, 38 users and no ratings, and says the developer has not identified as a trader; it links no website or source repository. The inspected version 1.1.1 package has a side panel where the user enters a Base URL, API key and model ID for an OpenAI-compatible chat API. The agent numbers the page's interactive DOM elements and calls four actions (open a new tab, click an element by index, type into an element by index, press a key), which bundled Puppeteer executes through the chrome.debugger protocol. No image input to the model was found in the package. The awesome-web-agents list describes the extension as using Claude Computer Use; the inspected version does not show that. Reliability was not tested.
summary: Chrome side-panel extension that runs a browser-use-style web agent: it indexes a tab's interactive elements and has a user-configured OpenAI-compatible model open tabs, click, type and press keys.
